company.text: Genmab (founded 1999, HQ Copenhagen; operations in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific) builds antibody medicines for cancer and other serious diseases across bispecifics, ADCs and immune-modulating antibodies. It closed the ~$8B acquisition of **Merus** on Dec 12, 2025 (petosemtamab). In 2026: epcoritamab + lenalidomide hit its Phase 3 PFS endpoint; Rina-S has FDA Breakthrough designation in endometrial cancer. On Jan 7, 2026 it announced a partnership with **Anthropic** for Claude-powered agentic AI in R&D.

financials.text: **H1 2026 revenue:** $2,051M (+25%). **Operating profit:** $555M (adjusted $656M). **Net profit:** $356M. **Cash:** $1,503M; borrowings $5,135M (Merus financing). **2026 guidance:** revenue $4.325–4.525B. **Headcount:** 3,119. Large R&D budget; decisions go through discovery leadership and procurement.
